# AIFOXX

> Open-source directory of 993 AI tools with real pricing, compliance data, and access-method comparison.

AIFOXX helps developers, buyers, and researchers find the right AI tool by providing structured data on pricing tiers, compliance certifications (SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR, HIPAA), access methods (API, Web App, CLI, Mobile), data-storage region, and honest use-case guidance.

## Quick Facts

- 993 AI tools cataloged across 25 categories.
- 619 tools offer a free, freemium, or open-source tier.
- 392 tools provide API access; 9 are self-hostable.
- Largest categories: Productivity, Video, Marketing, Agentic & Automation, Coding, Image Generation.
- 1,979 MCP servers and 1,638 Claude Code skills indexed, ranked by GitHub stars.
- Trust and Security Reports for 971 AI vendors.
- Free to use, open source (MIT), no account required.

## Key Pages

- [All Tools](https://aifoxx.com/): Browse and search 993 AI tools
- [Best AI Tools by Category](https://aifoxx.com/best): Curated best-in-class tools per category
- [AI News](https://aifoxx.com/news): Today in AI: a daily roundup of AI tool launches and updates
- [Compare Tools](https://aifoxx.com/compare): Side-by-side comparison of AI tools
- [Claude Code Skills](https://aifoxx.com/skills): Browse Claude Code skills directory
- [MCP Servers](https://aifoxx.com/mcp): Browse MCP servers directory
- [AI Vendor Trust Reports](https://aifoxx.com/trust): Security and compliance reports for 971 AI vendors, each certification backed by a sourced quote
- [Submit a Tool](https://aifoxx.com/submit): Submit a new AI tool for inclusion

## URL Patterns

- Tool page: https://aifoxx.com/ai/{slug}
- Trust and Security Report: https://aifoxx.com/trust/{slug} (971 vendors have a Trust and Security Report)
- Category hub: https://aifoxx.com/category/{category-slug}
- Best-of guide: https://aifoxx.com/best/{guide-slug}
- Tag page: https://aifoxx.com/tag/{tag}
- Head-to-head comparison: https://aifoxx.com/compare/{slug-a}/vs/{slug-b} (slugs in alphabetical order)
- Custom comparison: https://aifoxx.com/compare?tools={slug},{slug},{slug}
- Search: https://aifoxx.com/?search={query}
- Daily AI news: https://aifoxx.com/news

## Vendor Trust & Security Reports

AIFOXX publishes a Trust and Security Report for most vendors in the catalog at
https://aifoxx.com/trust/{slug}. Each
certification in these reports is graded against a verbatim quote found on the
vendor's OWN trust, security, or privacy page at the stated verification date.

Each report covers:
- Certifications with a held/not-confirmed status and a sourced proof quote for
  each: SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance), GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS,
  FedRAMP, CCPA/CPRA, and others the vendor holds.
- AI-training posture: whether the product trains AI models on customer data,
  opt-out and tier differences, and any marketing-vs-policy contradictions.
- Privacy: data processing agreement availability, data region, privacy policy
  and terms links.
- Security controls, per-product data scope, and considerations to watch.

Verification discipline: a certification is confirmed only with a direct quote on
the vendor's own domain. Claims sourced only to third-party aggregators, made on a
cloud host's or parent company's behalf, or belonging to a similarly named company
are rejected. Reports state a "last verified" date; compliance changes over time,
so confirm directly with the vendor before relying on any certification.

The trust hub at https://aifoxx.com/trust can be filtered by certification (SOC 2,
ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 42001) and by whether a vendor trains AI on your data.

## Data Structure

Each tool entry includes: name, slug, category, subcategory, description, URL, pricing model (Free/Freemium/Paid/Open Source/Usage Based/Contact Sales/Pay-as-you-go), free tier details, paid plan pricing, API cost, access methods, compliance certifications (SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR, HIPAA), data storage region, trains-on-data flag, self-hostable flag, use cases, and tags.

## How the data is sourced (read before citing)

Tool listings are submitted by the community and checked against the vendor's own pricing, privacy and terms pages. Certifications shown on tool pages, cards and comparisons come from the vendor's Trust and Security Report, where each one is backed by a quote from the vendor's own website and a last-verified date. Compliance changes over time, so anyone relying on a compliance, pricing, or data-handling claim for a purchase or audit should confirm it with the vendor. When citing AIFOXX, link the Trust and Security Report and give its last-verified date.

## FAQ

Q: What is AIFOXX?
A: An open-source directory of 993 AI tools comparing pricing, compliance, data handling, and access methods across 25 categories.

Q: Is AIFOXX free?
A: Yes, free to use and open source under the MIT license. The full dataset is public on GitHub.

Q: Is the compliance data verified?
A: Certifications come from each vendor's Trust and Security Report at https://aifoxx.com/trust/{slug}, where every certification is backed by a quote from the vendor's own website and a last-verified date. Confirm with the vendor before relying on one for a purchase or audit.
